caption: The trial ran on Business Annual, not on a monthly plan: $276.00 for the year, billed on 26 November 2026 when the 7 days end.
End free trial sits in a Danger zone under Plan and billing. Afterwards your numbers are kept for 30 days but calls and texts stop. The card digits are hidden.
The Sona call flow: ring users for 30 seconds, hand a missed call to Sona, then fall back to voicemail. We made no real call. Our workspace name in the greeting is hidden.
Automations on the Primary number: Auto record calls and Transcribe and summarize calls are on, while the audible recording notification is off.
Cancelling took one reason dialog, with no discount offer and no password. The trial stayed active until 26 November.
